seo.title: Two-Level Sports Bar & Rooftop in Carlsbad, CA | Park 101
seo.description: Two-level sports bar and restaurant in Carlsbad, CA with a courtyard, rooftop patio, 20+ screens and happy hour 3–6 PM. Reserve a table or order online.

hero.eyebrow: Carlsbad Village · One Block From The Beach
hero.heading: Park 101: Two-Level Sports Bar, Restaurant & Rooftop Patio in Carlsbad, CA
hero.body: Carlsbad Village's rooftop restaurant, sports bar and game day destination.

venue.heading: Rooftop Bar, Courtyard & Indoor Bar
venue.body: Three distinct spaces under one open sky. The central courtyard with the massive LED wall. The elevated rooftop deck with views of Carlsbad Village. The indoor bar with wall-to-wall screens and long communal tables. One block from the beach.

sports.heading: Sports Bar Game Day, Cold Drinks & 20+ Screens

sportsBanner.heading: Home of the Buffalo Bills
sportsBanner.body: Every game. Every season. Park 101 is Carlsbad's official home for Bills fans — outdoor LED wall, full menu, and cold drinks from kickoff to the final whistle.

drinks.heading: Rooftop Cocktails, Margaritas & Craft Beer
drinks.body: Signature cocktails, frozen margaritas, local craft beers on draft, and the Rodeo Tower — Park 101's most celebrated creation.

events.heading: Live Music & Weekly Events
events.body: Country nights. Live bands. Padres watch parties. UFC fight nights. From kickoff to the final buzzer, from the first song to last call — something's always happening at Park 101.

brunch.heading: Rooftop Brunch in Carlsbad
brunch.body: Open-air rooftop seating, breakfast favorites, brunch cocktails and the Rodeo Tower. Brunch is served daily until 2 PM in Carlsbad Village.

privateEvents.heading: Private Event Space for Birthdays & Corporate Events
privateEvents.body: Birthday parties, corporate happy hours, game day buyouts, rehearsal dinners — Park 101's rooftop, courtyard and indoor spaces can host everything from smaller groups to full venue buyouts.
